Midnight Paint Splash brings expressive color to family matching with a dark navy and black base scattered in vivid blue, teal, red, orange, and yellow paint-like marks. The open-collar button-up silhouette makes the energetic print easy to style over a plain undershirt or wear on its own for coordinated outings and family portraits.

The supplied chart provides recommended body height and weight only; chest, sleeve, pant or short, hip, waist, and garment-length measurements are unavailable and remain marked as such. It publishes one shared child-and-adult size ladder rather than separate girl, boy, mom, and dad measurements, so the picker uses honest Child and Adult labels without inventing role-specific variants.

Key Features:

  • One coordinated shirt: The same collared short-sleeve button-up look with a chest pocket is offered across child and adult sizes.
  • Expressive abstract print: A dark ground and bright multicolor paint-splash motifs create a bold, photo-ready family palette.
  • Easy warm-weather layer: The relaxed button-up shape works over a simple undershirt or as a standalone top.
  • Wide size ladder: Seven child rows and seven adult rows are preserved from the supplied chart.
  • Chart-backed variants: Every selectable size corresponds to one supplied chart row, with unavailable measurements left unguessed.
